title: Пассивный залог: Present и Past Simple

why: Пассив (страдательный залог) нужен, когда важно само действие или его результат, а не тот, кто его выполняет: «Письмо было отправлено», «Здесь говорят по-английски». В русском похожую роль играют безличные конструкции и «-ся» («это делается»), а в английском для этого есть чёткая форма.
formation: • Present Simple Passive: am / is / are + V3 (третья форма глагола)
English is spoken here. / These cars are made in Japan.
• Past Simple Passive: was / were + V3
The email was sent yesterday. / The windows were cleaned.
• Отрицание: The office isn't cleaned every day. / The report wasn't finished.
• Вопрос: Is the code reviewed by two people? / Where were these photos taken?
• Исполнитель действия, если он важен, вводится через by: The app was created by a small team.
• Правильные глаголы: V3 = V + ed (cleaned). Неправильные учим по таблице: write - wrote - written, make - made - made, build - built - built.
usage: My bike was stolen last night. (Мой велосипед украли прошлой ночью.)
2. Исполнитель очевиден или это общие правила и процессы.
The tickets are checked at the entrance. (Билеты проверяют на входе.)
This bridge was built in 1990. (Этот мост построили в 1990 году.)
4. Официальный, научный, технический стиль (инструкции, новости, документация).
The data is stored in the cloud. (Данные хранятся в облаке.)
signalWords: by (кем), every day, yesterday, last year, in 2010, usually. Если подлежащим становится объект действия, а в русском предложении глагол стоит в неопределённо-личной форме («построили», «говорят»), почти всегда нужен пассив.
mistakes: ✗ The window broke by the boy. → ✓ The window was broken by the boy. (пропущен was и V3)
✗ The report was wrote yesterday. → ✓ The report was written yesterday. (после was нужна V3, не V2)
✗ This book is writing by a famous author. → ✓ This book was written by a famous author. (не -ing, а V3)
✗ Cars are make in Germany. → ✓ Cars are made in Germany. (V3 обязательна)
✗ I was born in 1990 year. → ✓ I was born in 1990. (born всегда в пассиве)
remember: Be в нужном времени + V3: is/are made сейчас, was/were made в прошлом.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в Present Simple Passive или Past Simple Passive

items.prompt: English ___ (speak) in many countries.
This bridge ___ (build) in 1995.
These phones ___ (make) in China.
My wallet ___ (steal) yesterday.
The rooms ___ (clean) every morning.
The email ___ (send) two hours ago.
Lunch ___ (serve) at one o'clock every day.
The windows ___ (break) during the storm.
The film (a) was directed (b) directed by Steven Spielberg.
This museum (a) visits (b) is visited by many tourists every year.
This book (a) was written (b) wrote in 1925.
My car (a) is repaired (b) was repaired yesterday.
Coffee (a) grows (b) is grown in Brazil.
The documents (a) was signed (b) were signed by the director.
The Eiffel Tower (a) was build (b) was built in 1889.
Our products (a) sell (b) are sold in more than 20 countries.

exercises.instruction: Преобразуйте предложение из актива в пассив

items.prompt: They make cheese in France. -> Cheese ___.
Someone stole my bike. -> My bike ___.
A famous architect designed this building. -> This building ___.
items.answer: was designed by a famous architect

items.prompt: The team tests the app every week. -> The app ___.
items.answer: is tested by the team every week

items.prompt: They didn't invite me to the party. -> I ___.
items.answer: wasn't invited to the party / was not invited to the party

items.prompt: Make a question in the passive: When / this house / build?
They don't open the shop on Sundays. -> The shop ___ on Sundays.
Make a question in the passive: Where / these cars / make?
The letter was wrote yesterday.
English speaks in many countries.
items.answer: English is spoken in many countries.

items.prompt: This house built in 1950.
The cars are make in Germany.
items.answer: The cars are made in Germany.

items.prompt: The window was broke by the children.
items.answer: The window was broken by the children.

items.prompt: Where did these photos take?
I was born in 1992 year.
The rooms is cleaned every day.
items.answer: The rooms are cleaned every day.

items.prompt: Мой ноутбук украли вчера.
Этот сайт был создан в 2018 году.
items.answer: This website was created in 2018. / This site was created in 2018. / This website was made in 2018.

items.prompt: Английский язык используется во всём мире.
items.answer: English is used all over the world. / English is used around the world. / English is used worldwide.

items.prompt: Код проверяется двумя разработчиками.
items.answer: The code is reviewed by two developers. / The code is checked by two developers.

items.prompt: Где сделана эта фотография?
items.answer: Where was this photo taken? / Where was this picture taken?

items.prompt: Билеты не были проверены на входе.
items.answer: The tickets weren't checked at the entrance. / The tickets were not checked at the entrance.

items.prompt: Меня пригласили на собеседование на прошлой неделе.
items.answer: I was invited to an interview last week.

items.prompt: В этом ресторане подают завтрак с семи часов.
items.answer: Breakfast is served from seven o'clock in this restaurant. / Breakfast is served from seven in this restaurant. / Breakfast is served from seven o'clock at this restaurant.
